Across the laminated resin, fresh cracks tearing shear or plastic deformation radiates from that localized contact point under visible load. Her ram, leading shoulder, and one knee occupy that coherent passage. Translucent debris dust fluid fragments or deformation traces remain localized along the contact-to-passage path beside the aperture. Use a low three-quarter portrait centered on the approach-contact-passage axis.
